[Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has self-deleted its initial executable to operate in memory.(Citation: CyberAus_Vidar_May2026) [Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has deleted collected data after exfiltration.(Citation: Cyfirma_Vidar_June2024) [Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has also deleted the file Malware.exe and all .dll files in the ProgramData folder using the command `del /f /q “C:\Users\MalWorkstation\Desktop\Malware.exe” &
del C:\ProgramData\*.dll`.(Citation: Logpoint_StealerMalwareFamilies_2024)
